title: Joint Panel / Reduced-Rank Cross-Market Prediction

allowed_pre_freeze_material: 005A role-quality/reconstruction semantics only; no 005A price-response outcome used

scope.predictors: price/fill-derived panel returns plus missingness/age masks only

reconstruction.economic_subfill_rule: retain passive OrderFilled rows (is_exchange_taker=false) as one row per matched passive subfill; active rows are audit-only
reconstruction.valid_group_rule: at least one active row, at least one passive row, exactly one unique active signed-order owner
reconstruction.same_condition_second_aggregation: share-weighted canonical YES price across valid passive subfills
reconstruction.zero_size_rows: exclude from price aggregation and report
reconstruction.duplicate_policy: exact source identity duplicates fail audit; no multi-party OrderFilled row is treated as an independent economic trade beyond passive subfills

coordinates.clip_rule: clip p to [eps,1-eps] before logit only; preserve unclipped p for robustness and report clipping counts

panel_universe.ranking_for_cap: descending prefix economic observation count, then condition_id ascending

grid.decision_alignment: UTC epoch integer multiples of grid interval
grid.decision_candidate_rule: grid instants adjacent to at least one panel economic observation; do not materialize all-empty clocks
grid.feature_asof_rule: strictly observed before decision second t
grid.target_interval_rule: [t,t+h); at least one new target-market economic observation is required
grid.return_observed_rule: at least one market observation in [t-grid,t) and valid as-of states at both endpoints
grid.missing_feature_rule: standardize observed TRAIN return values; impute missing standardized return to 0 only with explicit observed mask and normalized age feature
grid.quiet_market_rule: missing/unobserved is never silently converted to an observed zero return

targets.definition: future as-of price minus decision as-of price, requiring >=1 new observation in [t,t+h)

baselines.B2: B1 plus leave-target-out contemporaneous cross-market mean return, observed fraction, and mean age

M4.name: reduced-rank predictive matrix
M4.construction: SVD of TRAIN-fitted coefficient matrix B; truncate to B_k=U_k Sigma_k V_k^T

models.rank_cap: min(candidate rank, feature dimension, evaluable target dimension)

joint_candidate_requirements: positive pooled MSE improvement versus selected B2
positive median per-target MSE improvement versus selected B2
at least 50% of evaluable targets helped
positive improvement in at least 3 of 5 contiguous DEV time blocks

evaluation_metrics: sign accuracy on nonzero observed targets

uncertainty.block_unit: contiguous decision-time blocks; aggregate losses before resampling
uncertainty.panel_weighting: equal panel weight for cross-panel summaries

ablations: remove strongest source market one at a time based on TRAIN coefficient norm
remove highest-activity source market based on TRAIN observation count
remove one metadata subgroup/event where feasible
delayed-panel placebo by one full target horizon
